name: Imouto Paradise! 2 ~Onii-chan to Gonin no Imouto no Mo~tto! Ecchi Shimakuri na Mainichi~
original_name: 妹ぱらだいす！２～お兄ちゃんと5人の妹のも～っと！エッチしまくりな毎日～
source:
This is the sequel to Imouto Paradise!. 

It’s summer vacation and Keiichi’s parents left him with his five younger sisters to go on an overseas trip. Now with their parents far out of the picture, his younger sisters are aggressively making their moves on him. Of course there’s no way he can hold back.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《Imouto Paradise!》的续集。

暑假到了，庆一的父母留下他和五个妹妹一起去海外旅行。现在，父母已经远离了他的视线，他的妹妹们正积极地对他采取行动。他当然没有办法阻止。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
